posts.name: Paul
posts.cooked: It doesn't look like we are going to be able to send out tracking numbers for domestic Kickstarter orders. There are just too many of them, and the format we have for things from fedex is not at all conducive to finding individual orders, unfortunately. If there is a problem with delivery, we could look something up, but it will take 5-10 minutes per order (possibly including a call to FedEx). Everyone in the US who did not specify USPS shipping (or give a PO/APO box) should get their games by mid-next week, and everyone else should get theirs by the week after. If not, message me about it.
